name: Fraction and decimal pairs
rule: Learn the friendly pairs: 1/2 = 0.5, 1/4 = 0.25, 1/5 = 0.2, 1/8 = 0.125, 1/10 = 0.1. Then count them up: 3/4 is three quarters.
why: Money is the shortcut: a quarter is 1/4 of a dollar, so 3 quarters is 75¢ = 0.75. Fractions and decimals are two names for the same amount.
workbookSection: Unit 2: Lessons 2.1 to 2.4 (unit rates and k)

clues: Think of a friendly piece: 1/{d} of 1. What is it as a decimal?
1/{d} = {unit}. Count how many pieces you have.
Which friendly fraction (halves, fourths, fifths, eighths, tenths) is close to {dec}?
{dec} is {n} of those {d}ths. Write it as a fraction.
